components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default high-confidence admin action; Familiar A public and bowler controls inherit Instrument Sans from their scoped shell.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis admin action with a clear boundary; Familiar A controls inherit their scoped type.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Shared form-field structure; Familiar A public and bowler screens use their route-scoped type and control styling.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Enter a value" aria-label="Example field" />
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White operational surface over the admin app shell; Familiar A bowler pages use their scoped page surfaces.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: var(--radius); background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 1.125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.375rem 0 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact semantic status or context marker; color communicates meaning across both interface systems.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 600 0.75rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar route row in the admin shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); color: oklch(86.9% 0.022 252.894); text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(27.9% 0.041 260.031); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(67.3% 0.182 276.935); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: oklch(58.5% 0.233 277.117 / 0.1); color: oklch(67.3% 0.182 276.935); }

components.name: Bowler Mobile Navigation Item
components.description: One of four touch-oriented bottom-navigation items in the shipped Familiar A bowler shell.
components.css: .ds-bowler-nav-item { display: flex; min-width: 0; width: 100%; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.125rem; border-radius: 7px; color: #475569; text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 "Instrument Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bowler-nav-icon { display: flex; width: auto; min-width: 42px; height: 29px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 7px; } .ds-bowler-nav-item:hover { color: #0f172a; } .ds-bowler-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { color: #0f172a; font-weight: 650; } .ds-bowler-nav-item[aria-current="page"] .ds-bowler-nav-icon { background: rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08); } .ds-bowler-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(30 58 138 / 0.34); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Familiar A Production Design with a Distinct Admin Interface
narrative.overview:
LeagueVault has two production interface systems. Public account pages and authenticated bowler pages use Familiar A: Instrument Sans, navy structure, cool-gray and white surfaces, and responsive branded framing. The staff/admin interface retains its incumbent system-sans typography, dark navy navigation, and blue-violet active-navigation accent.

On phones, the Familiar A bowler shell centers the official Perfect Game logo on a navy brand bar, places the league selector below it, and uses a white four-item bottom navigation. At desktop widths it uses a navy sidebar and white league header. Public account pages use a desktop story-and-form layout that collapses to a compact branded navy bar on phones. Production code defines behavior and responsive implementation; DESIGN.md records the current visual system. The standalone preview is a fictional reference and experiment lab.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar A uses Instrument Sans, navy primary actions, cool-gray surfaces, and restrained borders and shadows.
Public account pages use a desktop story panel and form canvas, collapsing to a branded navy bar on phones.
The mobile bowler shell has a navy logo bar, league selector, and white four-item bottom navigation; desktop uses a navy sidebar and white league header.
Bowler active navigation uses navy on a pale navy-gray surface; admin active navigation retains the blue-violet accent.
The admin interface retains its incumbent system-sans type and compact operational layout.

rules.name: The Status-by-Meaning Rule
rules.body: State colors communicate operational meaning; they are not decorative accents. Preserve distinct danger, success, warning, caution, and information roles when adding or redesigning components.

rules.name: The Scoped Type Rule
rules.body: Use Instrument Sans for shipped Familiar A public and bowler surfaces and retain the system-sans stack for staff/admin surfaces. Keep a restrained hierarchy and do not introduce additional fonts without a design decision.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surfaces and borders before adding stronger shadows. Elevation should clarify a plane, dialog, or active interaction rather than decorate a routine data surface.

dos: Do use shared semantic tokens from client/src/index.css and the existing route-scoped Familiar A stylesheets, including familiar-bowler-shell.css, familiar-bowler-pay.css, and public-page-layout.css, instead of inventing one-off colors.
Do preserve the distinct admin and Familiar A surface, typography, and navigation rules.
Do make keyboard focus visible with the established ring-and-offset treatment.
Do keep public, bowler, and admin responsive behavior aligned with their shipped production routes.
Do use borders and tonal layering before stronger shadows on operational content.
Do honor reduced-motion behavior and provider-required payment control styling.
donts: Do not treat the Familiar A bowler and public system as a pending concept; it is shipped in production.
Do not apply Familiar A styling to admin pages or admin blue-violet active navigation to bowler navigation without a design decision.
Do not replace Familiar A Instrument Sans or the admin system-sans stack without a design decision.
Do not use danger, warning, success, or information colors decoratively or interchangeably.
Do not remove semantic labels, focus states, responsive behavior, or loading/empty/error/recovery states while changing visual styling.
Do not normalize Square wallet and payment-provider controls without checking their provider requirements.
